title: Eric Hansen: a rook sacrifice sets up a fork
text: Hansen plays 27.Rxd7, giving up a rook for a knight. After 27...Rxd7, 28.Nf6+ forks the black king and both rooks. The game continues 28...Kf8 29.Bxc5. The existing detector gives no Brilliant award; Open Brilly Finder recognizes the sacrifice, matching the recorded review.

title: Aman Hambleton: a knight offer leads to mate
text: Hambleton offers his knight with 19.Nxg6. Black accepts: 19...Kxg6 20.Bxf5+ Kf7 21.Bg6+ Ke6 22.Qf5#. The existing detector misses the Brilliant label; Open Brilly Finder finds it, matching the recorded review. Stockfish’s first choice before the move was 19.Bxf5, so the old best-move rule excludes the played sacrifice.
